title: Views, Copies, and In-Place Updates knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes “View operations” in this lesson?
options: This topic removes the need to validate inputs or inspect model outputs.
This topic guarantees identical results across all devices and package versions.
This topic makes every serialized checkpoint safe to load from an unknown source.
Write down the expected axes and element count, then assert the observed shape. For layout-related topics, also check contiguity and whether storage is shared.
questions.answer_key: Write down the expected axes and element count, then assert the observed shape. For layout-related topics, also check contiguity and whether storage is shared.
questions.explanation: View operations: Write down the expected axes and element count, then assert the observed shape. For layout-related topics, also check contiguity and whether storage is shared.

questions.prompt: Before relying on “Copying tensors”, what should a learner verify?
options: Use the held-out test split repeatedly to tune the model and report that score as unbiased.
Skip recording package versions because they cannot affect API or device behavior.
check storage/view behavior and contiguity before relying on in-place edits or a downstream operation’s layout requirements.
Assume all tensor dimensions and devices are interchangeable without checking them.
questions.answer_key: check storage/view behavior and contiguity before relying on in-place edits or a downstream operation’s layout requirements.
questions.explanation: This lesson recommends the following check: check storage/view behavior and contiguity before relying on in-place edits or a downstream operation’s layout requirements.

questions.prompt: Which pitfall matters when applying “Aliasing and shared storage”?
options: Catch every exception and silently replace failed results with zeros.
Do not assume every view owns independent memory or that contiguous() is free; both aliasing and copies matter.
Change several unrelated settings at once and infer which change fixed the result.
Treat successful imports as proof that the full model and evaluation pipeline are correct.
questions.answer_key: Do not assume every view owns independent memory or that contiguous() is free; both aliasing and copies matter.
questions.explanation: This topic-specific caution is important: Do not assume every view owns independent memory or that contiguous() is free; both aliasing and copies matter.
